title: A sustainable biopolymer binder enables the fabrication of high-performance β-MnO2 cathodes for aqueous zinc-ion storage
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,6162-6172
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00939A, Paper
Selin Sariyer, Rezan Demir-Cakan
The β-MnO2-c-XG-CA cathode in zinc containing aqueous electrolyte retained a discharge capacity of 157 mAh g−1 after 200 cycles (73% retention), significantly outperforming β-MnO2-PVDF (76 mAh g−1, 37% retention).
